arguments.value: Faith S. Hochberg, born in 1950 in East Orange, New Jersey, served as a United States District Judge for the District of New Jersey from 1999 until her retirement in 2015. She earned a B.A. from Tufts University in 1972 and a J.D. from Harvard Law School in 1975. Earlier in her career, she clerked for Judge Spottswood Robinson of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit, served as special assistant to the chairman of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, practiced law in Newark, New Jersey, worked as an Assistant U.S. Attorney for the District of New Jersey, held senior legal and law enforcement positions in the U.S. Department of the Treasury, and served as U.S. Attorney for the District of New Jersey from 1994 to 1999.
